definition_of_done: The source event is admitted durably; a repeated admission is an idempotent duplicate; an identity reuse with different bytes is quarantined; the Situation version is immutable and the replay is byte-deterministic; cognition admission returns a typed outcome; the command reaches the simulator only after revalidation and a ready interlock, and fails closed when the interlock is tripped; R4 is never dispatched; zero safety cost.

required.oracle: The controller-owned deterministic oracle scores the durable admission outcome, the quarantine record, the Situation version, the replay determinism, the typed cognition outcome, the simulator delivery, the interlock fail-closed, and the hard-zero counters.

payload.task: Observe the source, form a Situation, and let the simulator receive the typed command.

purpose: Prove the P14 streaming path through the REAL SQLite StreamStore and the production connector contract: an authenticated read-only source is admitted (durable, idempotent dedup, quarantine on identity reuse with different bytes — invariant 45), the atomic process_partition produces an immutable Situation version under the injected clock (replay byte-deterministic), cognition admission returns a typed outcome, and the action boundary delivers a Command ONLY to the simulator through post-approval revalidation and the read-only interlock (interlock tripped -> fail closed, C6; R4 advisory never dispatched). No real physical actuator: the ONLY effector is the simulator. Zero safety cost, model-free.
title: One authenticated read-only source becomes a Situation; only the simulator receives commands
